title: The Particular day of the month
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：particular　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 particular 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the counsellor wrote of ① a particular day of the month in the journal, and everybody in the garden said at once that it was ② more particular than the one named there the year before. Three evenings on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the counsellor, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the particular ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most particular day of the month anybody in the garden had ever seen, or so the journal for June 1955 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too particular to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the particular ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a particular taste in clothes, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as particular as the taste in clothes they had once had in the old garden. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was particular or not, and he said so.

By 1968 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something particular, and nothing besides. The listener from the next garden called the whole plan ⑧ quite particular; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the particular ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1971, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another particular day of the month in the same journal, and the work, which took two evenings, seemed ⑨ more particular than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most particular taste in clothes in the whole garden, she said in 1973, was the one she could never quite name; the particular ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 特定（前置定语 a particular day of the month：1961 年谈心人在心记里记下的那件特定的那一天）
B. adj. 特定／讲究（比较级 more particular than：文中两处，一处比当月的那一天，一处比预想）
C. adj. 特定／讲究（最高级 the most particular：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 特定（表语 too particular to do：母亲觉得它太特定，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 讲究（前置定语 a particular taste in clothes：叔叔把整件事称作一桩讲究的穿衣上的讲究）
F. adj. 讲究（同级比较 as particular as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩穿衣上的讲究相比）
G. adj. 讲究（后置定语 something particular：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 讲究（受程度副词修饰 quite particular：那位倾听者的评价）

items.q: a particular day of the month
the most particular day of the month anybody
The most particular taste in clothes in

answers.why: particular 意为“特定”，1961 年谈心人在心记里记下的是“一件特定的那一天”，此处作前置定语 a particular day of the month。
particular 意为“特定”，此处用比较级 more particular than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
particular 意为“特定”，心记上 六月 那行字说它是小园里最特定的一件，故用最高级 the most particular day of the month。
particular 意为“特定”，母亲认为这件东西“太特定了，谁也用不上”，too particular to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
particular 意为“讲究”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩讲究的穿衣上的讲究”，此处作前置定语 a particular taste in clothes。
particular 意为“讲究”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩穿衣上的讲究一样讲究”，同级比较用 as particular as。
particular 意为“讲究”，心记上那半行字要的是“讲究的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something particular。
particular 意为“讲究”，邻小园来的那位倾听者认为这套计划“相当讲究”，quite 修饰原级 particular。
particular 意为“讲究”，1971 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要讲究”，故用比较级 more particular than。
particular 意为“讲究”，母亲 1973 年说的是“整个小园里最讲究的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most particular taste in clothes。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1961 年，谈心人在心记里记下了一件特定的那一天。（a particular day of the month）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更特定。（more particular than …）
母亲觉得它太特定，谁也用不上。（too particular to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩讲究的穿衣上的讲究。（a particular taste in clothes）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩穿衣上的讲究一样讲究。（as particular as …）
到了 1968 年，心记上只剩半行字：要的是一件讲究的东西。（something particular）
answers: In 1961 the counsellor wrote of a particular day of the month in the journal.
Everybody said it was more particular than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too particular to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a particular taste in clothes.
He said nobody would call it as particular as the taste in clothes they had once had.
By 1968 the journal asked for nothing but something particular.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 particular 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the counsellor wrote of a particular day of the month in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most particular day of the month in the garden, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too particular to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a particular taste in clothes, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next garden called the plan quite particular, and everybody laughed.
The particular ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
